name: cliamp-2b6b27f1-blind30-ots
instr:
# cliamp gives wrong answers across playback, storage and scripting — without a test suite

The repository has received 30 separate undocumented edits. What follows is everything I have been able to pin down by using the program.

This is a terminal program for listening to music — files of my own, live broadcasts and audio pulled off the web — and it now gets a long list of small things wrong. Nothing about my machine changed and nothing about the services it talks to changed; the same things I did last week come back differently.

Some of it is what I see while music is playing. In the little column of one-character marks in front of each row, two of the four marks no longer appear: the cursor arrow, the playing triangle and the exclamation mark for a file that cannot be played still show up, but the letter flagging the song lined up to play next and the star flagging a bookmarked one are simply absent from the rendered rows, even with colour stripped away. While a short status message is still on screen and nothing has been written to the log area, the interface decides it is completely idle and drops to its slowest refresh cadence, so nothing moves while a message is still pending. In the animated bar display the three lowest bands come out equal to one another instead of rising from one to the next, so the low end is flat where it used to be graded.
